answer: Work-slot deposit bond: each agent claims one timber-yard slot and locks a 70-credit deposit. A shift signal opens the day's slots; the agent must file an ember receipt proving kiln work, or the deposit burns. One receipt covers one slot: a rented ember receipt carries one serial, and one serial on two claims burns both. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 slots, locking 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent claims once, files once, keeps its deposit.
